Armstrong would relish Rangers switch - gossip
- Published
Romania-based winger eyes reunion with manager at Ibrox as Celtic hero reveals approach from Rangers...
Dinamo Bucharest winger Danny Armstrong is keen to move to Rangers in January, having worked under Ibrox boss Derek McInnes at Kilmarnock. (Football Insider, external)
Celtic target Simon Ebonog will be available for less than £5m in January as Le Havre struggle at the bottom of Ligue 1. (Football Insider, external)
Christian Borchgrevink and Rogers Mato are back in training at Hearts but Calvin Miller has suffered a fitness set-back. (Edinburgh Evening News - subscription required, external)
Inverness Caledonian Thistle manager Scott Kellacher believes Aberdeen duo Alfie Stewart and Alfie Bavidge are destined to shine in the Premiership but hopes the loanees will be allowed to see out the season with his club in the Championship after the arrival of new Dons boss Mario Frick. (Press & Journal - subscription required, external)
St Johnstone v Falkirk will be a first Scottish Premiership fixture for 23-year-old referee Cameron Stirling. (Courier - subscription required, external)
Rangers flop Russell Martin, currently with Leicester City and Celtic-linked Robbie Keane are contenders for the Swansea City job after Vitor Matos left for French club Strasbourg. (The Herald - subscription required, external)
Besiktas have set a price of £25m for former Celtic striker Hyeon-gyu Oh as Tottenham show interest in the South Korea international. (Turkiye Gazetesi - in Turkish, external)
Tottenham winger Mikey Moore, 19, will not cut short his loan spell at Koln, seemingly ending hopes of a return to Rangers. (Daily Record - subscription required, external)
Celtic great Paul McStay says he turned down an approach by Rangers in 1992. (Sun, external)
